integrity: Every mathematical assertion is supported by a direct proof and reproducible finite tests; independent validation not performed.
scientific_limitations: Requires q >= 3 distinct symbols, one cyclic run of each; does not classify repeated-letter multi-run periods or binary q=2. Computer checks are finite, and unindexed equivalent prior work cannot be ruled out.
title: Exact Abelian complexity and plateau rigidity of circular distinct-run words
